verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS scraping platform like Apify, so the axis applies. The pack only shows building blocks: freely usable Docker base images, the SDK and Crawlee library, and support for your own proxies. None of these documents a way to self-host the Apify platform itself, so no credit is earned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
